title: TEHRAN,  October 25 - Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, delivered a speech at parliament’s session.
text:
TEHRAN,  October 25 - Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament, delivered a speech at parliament’s session."

"Source: Iran's Parliament"

"------"

"SOT1, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:21): "If the regime [of Israel] commits crimes and genocide against the Zionist scum in the region, and simultaneously Washington attempts to break the will of our nation through sanctions and military and economic terrorism and malice, it is a continuation of their hegemony.""

""
"SOT2, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi)-(00:22 - 00:56): "Americans believe that a few media levers of pressure or military threats can make this great nation surrender to them, unaware that the Iran of today is not the Iran of the Pahlavi [last dynasty] era of humiliation, but rather an impregnable fortress of self-belief, defensive authority, and steely will that will never allow any foreign power to decide the fate of this land and its dignity.""

""
"SOT3, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi)-(00:57 - 01:47): "We are not terrified, and we are ready to respond to any audacity against the territorial integrity of Great Iran with a response beyond their imagination. Therefore, the threat of a large-scale war or terrorism is not an issue that will cause the Iranian nation to back down from its rights and interests. As long as the Americans do not change their behavior, abandon their bullying and greedy nature, and tangibly and realistically compensate for their breached commitments on the ground, no claim will hold any credibility for the Islamic Republic of Iran.""

"SOT4, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, Speaker of the Iranian Parliament (Farsi)-(01:48 - 02:09): "As I have stated before, we have nothing new to say; it was the United States that entered the quagmire with wrong calculations and war against Iran, and now they are the ones who must take the necessary actions to save themselves.
